_comment: Roadworks preset (control_server 'roadworks', cloud traffic-control 'roadworks', run_scenarios). Inbound Riccarton Avenue toward the CBD (~390 m, 6 edges; ~430 veh in the AM peak) limited to 4 m/s (~14 km/h, a works zone) for the whole 06:30-07:30 run. Edge ids are real ids from Christchurch_Central_City_main_streets.net.xml (traced with sumolib); tests/test_roadworks_preset.py checks they exist.
